title: Fix hiding popovers that are removed or moved between documents
body: This catches a couple of bugs relating to calling popover methods on elements that are moved between documents during operations. - Fixes #9161. - Supersedes #9457. - Supersedes https://github.com/whatwg/dom/pull/1185. The removing steps run the hide popover algorithm, but it started by checking popover validity, which throws if the element is not connected. The removing steps run after the element has been removed from its parent, so this always failed, leaving the popover showing and in the top layer. The same applied if the element's node document was not fully active. Check popover validity now only requires the element to be connected and its node document to be fully active when the popover is expected to be hidden, that is, when showing it. In addition: * The hide popover algorithm now passes the document to check popover validity after firing beforetoggle and after hiding the popover stack, as the show popover algorithm does. Previously, if a beforetoggle event listener moved the popover to another document and showed it there, the original hide would go on to hide it in the new document. * The popover close watcher is now only destroyed when the hide popover algorithm completes, rather than whenever it returns early. Previously, bailing out could destroy the close watcher of a popover that was still showing, including one shown again in another document. * Calling hidePopover() on a showing popover whose node document is not fully active now hides it, rather than throwing an "InvalidStateError" DOMException. @keithamus - are you good to write the tests for this? - [x] At least two implementers are interested (and none opposed): * Mozilla * Chrome - [x] [Tests](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt) are written and can be reviewed and commented upon at: * https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/63185 - [x] [Implementation bugs](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) are filed: * Chromium: https://issues.chromium.org/issues/570738049 * Gecko: https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2079362 * WebKit: https://bugs.webkit.org/show_bug.cgi?id=326681 - [x] The top of this comment includes a [clear commit message](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/COMMITTING.md) to use. (See [WHATWG Working Mode: Changes](https://whatwg.org/working-mode#changes) for more details.) *** /popover.html ( diff )
